package domain

import (
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"strings"
	"unicode/utf8"

	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

const AssignedLessonContextSchemaVersion = "student-assigned-lesson-context.v1"
const MaximumAssignedLessonDescriptionBytes = 1 << 20

type AssignedLessonContent struct {
	Title       string `json:"title"`
	Excerpt     string `json:"excerpt"`
	Description string `json:"description"`
}

// AssignedLessonContext is a transient Student-owned frozen content projection.
// It is never persisted, logged, or copied wholesale into prompt variables.
type AssignedLessonContext struct {
	Schema             string                `json:"schema"`
	StudentID          string                `json:"student_id"`
	LearningPathID     string                `json:"learning_path_id"`
	LearningPathItemID string                `json:"learning_path_item_id"`
	CourseID           string                `json:"course_id"`
	LessonID           string                `json:"lesson_id"`
	LessonRevisionID   string                `json:"lesson_revision_id"`
	ContentDigest      string                `json:"content_digest"`
	Content            AssignedLessonContent `json:"content"`
}

func validAssignedUUID(value string) bool {
	if len(value) != 36 {
		return false
	}
	parsed, err := uuid.Parse(value)
	return err == nil && parsed != uuid.Nil && parsed.String() == value
}

func validAssignedContentDigest(value string) bool {
	if len(value) != 71 || !strings.HasPrefix(value, "sha256:") {
		return false
	}
	for _, c := range value[7:] {
		if (c < 'a' || c > 'f') && (c < '0' || c > '9') {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func NormalizeAssignedLessonContext(input AssignedLessonContext, studentID, pathID, itemID string) (AssignedLessonContext, error) {
	if input.Schema != AssignedLessonContextSchemaVersion || !validAssignedUUID(studentID) || !validAssignedUUID(pathID) || !validAssignedUUID(itemID) || input.StudentID != studentID || input.LearningPathID != pathID || input.LearningPathItemID != itemID || !validAssignedUUID(input.CourseID) || !validAssignedUUID(input.LessonID) || !validAssignedUUID(input.LessonRevisionID) || !validAssignedContentDigest(input.ContentDigest) {
		return AssignedLessonContext{}, ErrInvalidLessonContext
	}
	content := input.Content
	if !utf8.ValidString(content.Title) || !utf8.ValidString(content.Excerpt) || !utf8.ValidString(content.Description) || utf8.RuneCountInString(content.Title) > MaximumLessonOverviewTitleRunes || utf8.RuneCountInString(content.Excerpt) > MaximumLessonOverviewExcerptRunes || len(content.Description) > MaximumAssignedLessonDescriptionBytes {
		return AssignedLessonContext{}, ErrInvalidLessonContext
	}
	encoded, err := json.Marshal([3]string{content.Title, content.Excerpt, content.Description})
	if err != nil {
		return AssignedLessonContext{}, ErrInvalidLessonContext
	}
	digest := sha256.Sum256(encoded)
	if input.ContentDigest != "sha256:"+hex.EncodeToString(digest[:]) {
		return AssignedLessonContext{}, ErrInvalidLessonContext
	}
	return input, nil
}

func VerifyAssignedLessonContext(studentID, lessonID string, source *LessonMessageContext, content AssignedLessonContext) (LessonTeachingContext, error) {
	normalized, err := NormalizeCurrentLessonMessageContext(source)
	if err != nil || normalized.Schema != LessonMessageContextSchemaVersionV2 || !validAssignedUUID(lessonID) || normalized.LessonID != lessonID {
		return LessonTeachingContext{}, ErrInvalidLessonContext
	}
	content, err = NormalizeAssignedLessonContext(content, studentID, normalized.LearningPathID, normalized.LearningPathItemID)
	if err != nil || content.LessonID != lessonID || content.CourseID != normalized.CourseID || content.LessonRevisionID != normalized.ContentRevision || content.ContentDigest != normalized.ContentDigest {
		return LessonTeachingContext{}, ErrInvalidLessonContext
	}
	verified := LessonTeachingContext{Schema: normalized.Schema, Mode: normalized.Mode, CourseID: normalized.CourseID, LessonID: lessonID, ContentRevision: normalized.ContentRevision, LearningPathID: normalized.LearningPathID, LearningPathItemID: normalized.LearningPathItemID, ContentDigest: normalized.ContentDigest}
	if normalized.Mode == LessonMessageModeOverview {
		verified.Title = content.Content.Title
		verified.Excerpt = content.Content.Excerpt
	} else {
		if !strings.Contains(content.Content.Title, normalized.SelectedText) && !strings.Contains(content.Content.Excerpt, normalized.SelectedText) && !strings.Contains(content.Content.Description, normalized.SelectedText) {
			return LessonTeachingContext{}, ErrInvalidLessonContext
		}
		verified.SelectedText = normalized.SelectedText
	}
	return NormalizeLessonTeachingContext(verified)
}
